info.title: biohub-embryo-celltrack-v2.ipynb
info.subtitle: "Offline 3D Cell Tracking: DoG Detection, Hungarian Linking, Validated on GT"
info.description: The data consists of 3D+time (T×Z×Y×X) fluorescence microscopy volumes of a developing embryo, stored as .zarr files. Voxel physical scale is z=1.625 and y=x=0.40625 micrometers. The test folder contains only raw images; the train folder additionally includes .geff files — ground-truth tracking graphs storing each cell's coordinates per frame and the edges linking cells across time, including cell divisions.
